name: relay-ip-block
description: The relay's address is null-routed at the border: every packet toward it vanishes, on every port and protocol, while the rest of the world stays reachable. The failure the L3 address-swap rung exists for. Nothing gets through on any family.
analogue: IP blocking of a burned proxy address: the GFW's border ACL / null-route, and Iran's per-IP blocking of VPS addresses ('IPs on MCI burning in 2-7 days'). Model: one address, silent drop, permanent. It does not model the whole-prefix or whole-provider blocks (DigitalOcean, OVH) or the dynamic 3-tuple residual block.
